name: Amsterdam University College
summary: UvA and VU's joint liberal arts college at Amsterdam Science Park: one English BA/BSc, about 300 new students a year, all living on campus.

ib.text: IB Diploma accepted as VWO-equivalent. Predicted grades are not accepted: you are judged on your latest grades. English: IELTS 7.0 or TOEFL 100; IB English SL at 5 may count as alternative proof.

apply.via: Studielink, then AUC's online application form

dates.label: Late deadline, only if AUC announces one in March 2027

programmes.name: Liberal Arts and Sciences
programmes.ib: Maths by major: Sciences AA HL 5, AA SL 6 or AI HL 6 (lower with a science subject); Social Sciences AA HL 4, AA SL 5 or AI HL 6; Humanities AA SL 4, AI HL 4 or AI SL 7.

notes: AUC guarantees on-campus housing at Science Park for all three years; you pay a one-time €675 campus fee plus rent to DUWO.
You apply once per cycle to one major (Sciences, Social Sciences or Humanities), which sets your maths bar and cannot be changed during admission.
Early-bird applications are reviewed first with no cap on offers, so they stand a better chance than those sent by the regular deadline.
